content.title: Five-phase transformation roadmap delivers value in 18 months

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.title: Diagnose
phases.description: Q1 2026: Assess state, identify value pools, define model

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.title: Design
phases.description: Q2 2026: Develop blueprints, prioritize initiatives, design architecture

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.title: Pilot
phases.description: Q3 2026: Launch MVP, test tools, gather feedback

phases.name: Phase 4
phases.title: Scale
phases.description: Q4 2026 - Q1 2027: Roll out solutions, conduct training, monitor performance

phases.name: Phase 5
phases.title: Sustain
phases.description: Q2 2027 & beyond: Embed new practices, establish loops, measure benefits
